question: None shared. P-218 classifies current diagnosis (AD/MCI/NC) from 18F-FDG PET slices, and its AUC counts AD and MCI together as positives against NC. P-65 predicts 36-month conversion among MCI patients (pMCI vs sMCI) from baseline structural MRI. The comparison (impaired against normal vs converters against stable MCI) and the channel (PET vs MRI) both differ.
metric: ROC AUC in name for both, but on different contrasts: impaired vs NC from a 3-class model, against pMCI vs sMCI.

figures.P-218: ACC 89.4%, AUC 92.3% (SEN 87.43, SPE 88.26), on an ADNI-2 PET test set (124 AD/192 MCI/84 NC). No conversion endpoint and no MRI.
figures.P-65: AUC 0.8401 +/- 0.0297, ACC 0.7819, from ADNI 5-fold CV (300 pMCI/273 sMCI, sMRI). External OASIS-3: AUC 0.8137 +/- 0.0351. No diagnostic task and no PET.

matched_figure_check: None exists. P-218 reports no conversion analysis and no MRI; P-65 reports no diagnostic classification and no PET.
performance_validity: Passes: 0.923 and 0.840 are below 0.97. Not relevant, since the questions differ.
reason: P-218's 92.3% is an AD-plus-MCI vs NC AUC from FDG-PET, and P-65's 0.84 is a 36-month MCI-conversion AUC from structural MRI. The two share neither the clinical question nor the channel (condition 1). The record's 'T2' and 'structural_mri' labels for P-218 misread the paper (condition 6), and neither paper prints a figure under the other's question.
